title: 7. Ransomware Playbook Walkthrough
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L20: Incident Response: 7. Ransomware Playbook Walkthrough.

blocks.text: Concrete walkthrough of a ransomware incident applying the lifecycle:

items: Endpoint alert: mass file rename to .encrypted extension
User reports: ransom note on desktop, files won't open
SIEM: anomalous file write rate from one host
Isolate infected hosts from network — disconnect LAN, disable WiFi
Do NOT power off — RAM may contain encryption key or malware artifacts
Disable compromised user accounts
Block known C2 IPs/domains at firewall
Disconnect network shares (ransomware spreads via SMB)
How many systems are encrypted?
Patient zero — which user/system was infected first?
Are backups affected? (networked backups are usually encrypted too)
Did lateral movement occur?
Internal: SOC → IR Lead → CISO → Legal → Executive Management → PR
External (if applicable):
NCSA — if Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) operator (Thailand Cybersecurity Act)
PDPC — if personal data was breached (PDPA: 72 hours)
Law enforcement (DSI / Police) — for prosecution

blocks.text: Never issue a public statement before legal review. Legal may require silence to protect litigation; or may require disclosure under regulation.

`` ☐ RAM dump of every affected system (DumpIt, Magnet RAM Capture) ☐ Forensic disk image (FTK Imager) before reimage ☐ SIEM log export (window: pre/during/post incident) ☐ Process list + network connections (tasklist /v, netstat -ano) ☐ Ransom note saved as text ☐ Sample of encrypted files (some decryptors need them) ☐ SHA-256 hash of every evidence item + chain of custody form ``

items: ID Ransomware (id-ransomware.malwarehunterteam.com) — upload note or encrypted file
Check extension, ransom note language
Match to known family
No More Ransom (nomoreransom.org) — free decryptors aggregated by Europol partnership

rows: No guarantee, may violate sanctions, funds criminals

items: Identify initial access vector (phishing? RDP brute force? unpatched vuln?)
Patch vulnerability, rotate all credentials, remove persistence
Lessons learned within 2 weeks; update backup strategy (offline / immutable)

attribution: Course: ICCS423 | Source: Thoth + RAG | Target: 3rd-4th year CS | Date: 2026-05-03
cheatsheet: Do NOT power off: RAM may contain encryption key or malware artifacts
NCSA: if Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) operator (Thailand Cybersecurity Act)
PDPC: if personal data was breached (PDPA: 72 hours)
Restore from offline backup: Verified clean immutable backup exists
Rebuild from scratch: No backup or backup encrypted
Use decryptor: Free decryptor available for variant
